book.name: JUAN
book.title: JA' WATX' K'ANE TZ'IBEBIL CAN YU NAJ JUAN

content: Scamichal Naj Lázaro
Ja' bey jun aldea chi yij Betania, ey jun winaj chi yij Lázaro. Ya' ey naj. Ey cawan yanab naj Lázaro tu', ey jun chi yij María, ey jun xa chi yij Marta. A Betania c'al eb yoxwanil.
Ja' ix María tu', ja' ton jun jix aon oc jun ambal suk'uk'i sab yin Jesús Kaawil, catu' jix sjo'on taj yajan Jesús ix yetoj xil ya'. Caw ya' ey naj Lázaro tu'.
Yuxan jix yatoj sti' eb ix anabe tu' tet Jesús. Jix yal eb ix jaxca ti': —Mamin, ja' naj cam c'ulnebil ja wu, caw ya' ey naj tinani', ẍi eb.

Ja' yet jix yaben Jesús tzet jix yaltoj eb ix, catu' jix yalon naj jaxca ti': —Ja' jun ya'bil tu', man oj cam naj yu yin junelne. Jix mi'cha naj yu jun ya'bil tu', yet watx' chi x'ox el sba Dios tol miman yel oc apnoj naj, c'al yu x'oxon pax el oj, tol miman wel oc apnoj jain C'aale jin ti' an, ẍi Jesús.
Caw ey scam c'ulal Jesús yin naj Lázaro tu', c'al yin ix María yetoj ix Marta.
Pero ja' yet jix yaben tol caw ya' ey naj, ma toj naj yin eymanil yiloni. Scaabial xa tu', catu' jix toi.
Ja' yet jix apni sc'ual sto tu', jix yalon tet eb scuywom jaxca ti': —Toon nej bey lugar yul yet Judea junel xa, ẍi naj tet eb.
Catu' jix yalon eb tet naj: —Pero Wuẍtaj, jayeb jix to c'u yak'len eb yaawil ye bey Judea tu' jaach sk'ojch'ennen titu'. ¿Tumi cha woche chach to pax junel xa titu' tinani'? ẍi eb tet naj.
Jix yalon naj tet eb: —Kotaj, ey lacaweb hora yul jun jun c'u. Ta c'ualil chi cu ec'abi, man comon oj chi cu telc'oi, yutol saj k'inal.
Pero eb chi ec'ab yet ak'balil xin, comon c'al chi telc'o eb, yutol c'am saj k'inal eb, ẍi Jesús tet eb.
Jix lawi tu', jix yalon pax tej yu naj Lázaro: —Ja' naj kamigo tu', tol chi wey naj, pero oj jin toj jin ten el sweyan naj, ẍi naj tet eb.
—Pero Wuẍtaj, ta tol chi weyi, tejan oj wa'xoj sc'ul, ch'al tu', ẍi eb scuywom tu' tet Jesús.
Ja' yet jix yalon Jesús tol chi wey naj Lázaro tu', ja' scamichal chi yala. Pero ja' sna'on eb xin, ja' caw weyan chi yune'.
Yu jun tu', yuxan jix yalon naj junel xa tet eb jaxca ti': —Jix cam naj Lázaro.
Tinani' caw chin tzala an, yutol c'am jin ey jin ec' titu' yet jix cami, yet watx' che yaoc je c'ul win. Tinani' toon nej kila, ẍi naj tet eb.
Ja' naj Tomás, naj chi yij pax Tioẍ, jix yal naj tet eb yet cuywomal tu' jaxca ti': —Toon nej pax oj, to kak' cu ba cam yetoj, ẍi naj tet eb.
Ja' Jesús Ak'om K'inale Tol Ey C'al Yin Tobal K'inal
Ja' yet jix apni eb xin, jix yaben eb, tol oxi tax jix muji naj Lázaro tu'.
Ja' scawilal Jerusalén, ey conob Betania tu', jaxca snan oj legua xol.
Yu jun tu', yuxan ec'al eb a Jerusalén jix bet miman c'ulnen ix María yetoj ix Marta, yu jun sno eb jix cam tu'.
Ja' yet jix yaben ix Marta tol lalan yapni Jesús bey sna eb, jix to ix ẍa'oni. Jal ix María xin, jix can can ix yul sna.
Jix yalon ix Marta tet Jesús tu' jaxca ti': —Mamin, ta ey jaach ec' titi', ma mi cam naj jin no tu'.
Pero ja' tinani', wotaj an, yal c'al tzet oj ja k'an tet Dios, oj yak' e ach, ẍi ix tet naj.
—Ja' naj ja no tu', oj pitzc'u a naj, ẍi Jesús tet ix.
—Yel toni, wotaj an. Ja' yet slawub c'ual, yet oj pitzc'u a eb camnaj, catu' oj pitzc'u a naj yetoj eb, ẍi ix tet naj.
Catu' jix yalon Jesús tet ix jaxca ti': —Jainti', ak'om jin pitzc'u a camnaj, a k'inale jin pax oj. Yal c'al mac txequel chin yaoc yin sc'ul, cax c'al mi oj cam oj, pero oj pitzc'u pax a oj.
Masanil eb iquis to chin aon oc yin sc'ul, c'am bak'in oj cam eb, ¿Chim ja waoc jun ti' yin ja c'ul? ẍi Jesús tet ix.
—Chi ton waoc yin jin c'ul, Mamin, tol jaachti' Cristo jaach, Sc'aal jaach Dios. Jaach ton ti' echbanebil ja wul yul yiban k'inal ti' ẍi ix tet naj.
Jix Ok' Naj Jesús Yu Naj Lázaro
Jix lawi yalon ix Marta jaxca tu', jix pax toj ix. Jix to yawtentej sno ix. Yin ewantajil jix yun yalon ix tet sno tu' jaxca ti': —Jix jul naj Cuywam, chach yawte naj, ẍi ix.
Jix yab c'al ix María jaxca tu', catu' eyman jix a waan oj, catu' jix to ix bey ey ec' Jesús tu'.
Tutun c'am to chi oc Jesús tu' yul conob tu'. Ja' bey jix bet cha'le yu Marta, ja' tu' ey to ec' oj.

Pero ey ec' eb a Judea bey sna yetoj ix. Jix apni smiman c'ulnele ix yu eb. Ja' yet jix yilon eb, tol eyman jix a waan ix, catu' jix toi, eyman jix tzajlo eb yintaj ix, yutol ja' sna'on eb, tol ja' bey mujan naj sno tu' chi to ok' oj.
Ja' yet jix apni ix bey ey ec' Jesús tu', jix ey kaan ix sattaj naj. Catu' jix yalon ix tet naj jaxca ti': —Mamin, ta ey jaach ec' titi' ma mi cam naj jin no ti', ẍi ix tet.
Ja' yet jix yilon Jesús tol chi ok' ix, catu' chi ok' pax eb a Judea jix tzajlo yintaj ix tu', catu' jix cus pax a naj yetoj eb sic'lebil.
Catu' jix sk'anlen tet eb jaxca ti': —¿Beytu' jix je muj naj? ẍi naj tet eb. —Mamin, toon kila, ẍi eb tet Jesús.
Ja' yet tu' jix ok' naj Jesús tu'.
Catu' jix yalon eb a Judea ey ec' yilon tu', jaxca ti': —Ilala, caw cam c'ulnebil naj yu naj, ẍi c'al eb.
Ey pax eb jix alon jaxca ti': —Pero ja' Jesús ti', ja' jix jajon sat jun naj c'am chi ske' yilwi. ¿Tumi ma ske' yak'on jul sc'ul naj Lázaro ti', yet watx' c'am chi cami? ẍi eb.
Jix Pitzc'u A Naj Lázaro Yu Jesús
Caw jix tit pitz'na scus c'ulal Jesús yet jix apni bey mujan naj. Ja' yul jun ch'en jolbil, ja' titu' ey octoj smimanil naj. Patxan can oc jun xa ch'en smajil oj.
—I' wej el ch'en smajil ti', ẍi Jesús. Jix yalon ix Marta, ix yanab naj Lázaro tu' jaxca ti': —Pero Mamin, oxi tax jix cam naj. Tejan ey xa sab naj tinani', ẍi ix tet naj.
—Jix wal e ach, ta tol chin ja waoc yin ja c'ul, oj ton ja wil yipal Dios, ẍi naj tet ix.
Catu' jix yi'on el smajil eb bey ey octoj naj tu'. Jix a t'anan Jesús satcan, jix yalon naj jaxca ti': —Mamin, yu wal dios e ach, jix ja wab tzet jix wal an.

Wotaj xa tol tobal k'inal cha wab c'al ta' tzet chi wal an. Pero ja' yu jantaj ánima bulan ec' titi', yuxan chi wal wan ti' e ach, yet watx' oj yaoc eb yin sc'ul tol jaach jix jin ja chejtej, ẍi Jesús.
Jix lawi yalon naj wan tu', catu' jix a yaw yin ipal jaxca ti': —Lázaro, elantej, ẍi Jesús.
Catu' jix eltej naj camnaj tu'. Chulan oc wan k'ap yin yajan c'al yin sk'ab naj. Ey pax jun an xotan oc yalan sti'. Jix yal Jesús jaxca ti': —Xuy wej el wan k'ap ey oc yin naj tu', ẍi Jesús tet eb.
Jix Sey Eb Yaaw Tzet Utbil Chi Yute Yak'on Cam Jesús
Catu' ec'al eb a Judea ey ec' yetoj ix María tu', jix yil eb tzet c'al jix yun Jesús tu'. Yu jun tu', yuxan ec'al eb jix yaoc sc'ul yin.
Pero ey wan xa eb jix bet alon yab eb fariseo, tzettaj jix yun Jesús.

Catu' jix slatinen el sba eb fariseo tu' yetoj eb yaawil yak'omal xaambal eb tet Dios, c'al eb mimej winaj chi ak'on cuenta conob. Catu' jix yalon eb jaxca ti': —¿Tzet chi kute jun winaj ti' che na'? Yutol caw ey wan milagro lalan x'oxon tinani'.

Ta tu' c'al oj kil oc naj tinani', masanil eb ket conob oj yaoc sc'ul eb yin. Ja' eb yaaw bey Roma, oj jul yuche jun stemplo Dios eb ti', catu' oj yak'on jowal eb yin eb ket conob masanil. Caw oj cu can yalan yu eb naj, ẍi eb.
Pero ey jun naj chi yij Caifás xol eb. Ja' jun tu' ey oc yaawil yak'omal xaambal eb tet Dios yet jun jabil tu'. Ja' jix alon tet eb jaxca ti': —Jaexti', caw c'am nioj tzet je yotaj.
C'am chi na'cha el je yu, tol yel watx' chi cu cani ta chi cam junoj winaj sq'uexel oj ánima masanil. Ta quey tu' chi yune', c'am chi lawi el eb ket conob masanil, ẍi naj Caifás tu'.

Pero ja' yet jix yalon wan k'ane tu', man yul oj yet jix yaloni, pero yutol yaawil yak'omal xaambal eb Israel tet Dios ye yet jun jabil tu', yu jun tu', yuxan jix ak'le yal yu Dios tol oj cam Jesús sq'uexel oj eb Israel masanil.
Man asanne oj yu eb Israel tu', yuxan jix cami. Jix cam yu syamban oc jantaj eb yuninal Dios sajleminaj ye yul yiban k'inal ti', yet watx' junxane chi yun can eb.
Yu jun tu', yuxan ja' yet jun c'ual tu', jix ẍa' el yich eb yaaw tu' seyon tzet utbil oj yute yak'on cam Jesús eb.

Yu jun tu', yuxan c'am xa chi ec' Jesús snan xol eb a Judea tu'. Jix el bey jun lugar tu'. Catu' jix to bey jun conob chi yij Efraín sti'laj el jun cusiltaj tx'otx'. Ja' ta' titu' jix apni naj yetoj scuywom.

Ja' yet lalan xa sjul stiempoal jun sk'in eb Israel chi yij pascua, ec'al eb naat speto, catu' chi apni eb bey Jerusalén. C'am to chi oc k'in tu', catu' chi apni eb, yet watx' chi swa'ne sba eb jaxca ta' sbeybal.
Ja' yet ey ec' eb titu', caw jix seyle ec' Jesús yu eb, catu' ey eb jix alon yul stemplo Dios jaxca ti': —¿Tzet ẍi je c'ul? ¿Oj mi jul Jesús bey k'in ti', ma man oj jul che na'? ẍi eb.

Ja' yet tu' jix yi' eltej jun ley eb fariseo yetoj eb yaawil eb yak'omal xaambal eb Israel tet Dios tu'. Chi yal jun ley tu' jaxca ti': “Ta ey bey che yil yin Jesús, chi jul je yal titi',” ẍi. Quey tu' jix yun sajlem k'ane yu eb, yutol chi yoche eb chi yaoc naj preso.

footnotes.text: Ja' sbeybal eb Israel, tol chi chule oc wan an k'ab yin scamom eb, yuxan jix yal Jesús tol chi xuyle el an k'ab ey oc yin naj Lázaro tu'.
